w:r.w:t: This Software Requirements Specification (SRS) defines the complete functional and non-functional requirements for EmPay — a cloud-based Human Resource Management System (HRMS) targeted at startups, SMEs, and institutions. This document serves as the binding contract between stakeholders and the engineering team.
Out of scope for v1.0: mobile app, third-party payroll integrations, biometric attendance, document storage.
A specific payroll cycle during which salaries are processed
Official document showing earnings, deductions, and net pay per payrun
Provident Fund — 12% of basic salary contributed by employee AND employer
Professional Tax — state-levied monthly tax deducted from gross salary
Loss of Pay — deduction for unapproved absences
JSON Web Token — stateless auth token
Admin can register via a seeded super-admin account. Subsequent admins are created by existing admins.
All users authenticate via email + password. System returns a JWT (exp: 8h). Tokens must be invalidated on logout.
Users can request a password reset link via registered email. Token expires in 15 min.
Admin assigns one of four roles: Admin / HR Officer / Payroll Officer / Employee at account creation.
All users can view and edit their own profile (name, phone, profile photo).
Admin and HR Officer can edit any employee's profile.
Employee marks attendance once per day. System records timestamp, date, and status (Present / Late / Absent).
Employee views their own daily attendance log with status indicators.
Calendar view of monthly attendance with summary (working days, present, absent, leaves).
HR Officer can view attendance records of ALL employees. Can filter by date range and employee.
Admin can manually edit attendance entries (mark/unmark) with an audit note.
Employee submits leave request: type (Sick/Casual/Earned/Unpaid), from date, to date, reason.
Employee views status of all their leave requests: Pending / Approved / Rejected.
Payroll Officer approves or rejects time-off requests. Approval triggers payroll recalculation flag.
HR Officer allocates leave quotas per employee per year. System tracks consumed vs. remaining.
System supports: Casual Leave (12/yr), Sick Leave (12/yr), Earned Leave (15/yr), Unpaid Leave (unlimited).
Admin/Payroll Officer defines CTC, basic salary %, HRA %, and allowances per employee.
Payroll Officer triggers monthly payrun. System auto-calculates based on attendance + approved leaves.
System auto-computes: PF (12% basic), Professional Tax (slab-based), LOP (per absent day).
After payrun, system generates downloadable PDF payslip for each employee.
Payroll Officer can manually adjust line items before finalizing. Changes logged with reason.
Employee can view and download their own payslips. Cannot view others.
Admin Dashboard: total employees, today's attendance %, pending leaves, upcoming payrun date.
Attendance chart: monthly bar chart of present / absent / leave per department.
Leave summary: pie chart of leave type distribution.
Payroll summary: monthly payroll expenditure line graph.
Employee directory: searchable, filterable table (HR Officer and Admin only).
API response time < 300ms for 95% of requests under 50 concurrent users.
Passwords hashed with bcrypt (saltRounds=12). JWT signed with RS256. HTTPS enforced.
System uptime target: 99.5% (hackathon demo window). Graceful error handling on all endpoints.
Architecture must support horizontal scaling. Stateless backend. DB connection pooling.
UI must be responsive (mobile + desktop). Page load < 2s on 4G connection.
All data mutations (payroll edits, attendance overrides) logged with user ID, timestamp, before/after.
Approved Casual / Sick / Earned Leave: no LOP deduction — counted as paid.
Approved Unpaid Leave: LOP deduction applied per day.
Unapproved Absence: LOP deduction applied per day.
Half-day leave: 0.5 days LOP if unpaid, else 0.
Get own attendance log (filtered by month/year)
View all leave requests (Payroll Officer / Admin)
All employees work in a single timezone (IST by default).
Working days are Monday–Friday (5 days/week, ~22 working days/month).
One attendance record per employee per day.
Salary is monthly; all calculations done at month-end.
Professional Tax follows Maharashtra slab structure for v1.0.
Must be deployable in < 24 hours on a single server/VPS or free cloud tier.
Email service: SMTP via Nodemailer or SendGrid free tier.
